about: The Learn replay fences as walkable games (WO-STORY-MATRIX-01 P1-0): real games walked by hand (the source test names each), with the engine reads the Danya bench takes, so the decision baseline walks them with no engine. reads[k] belongs to ply k+1: before = the board ply k+1 was played on (MultiPV 5), after = the board after it (MultiPV 3); White point of view, a mate kept as its distance. Read by scripts/bench/danya-reads.mjs, native Stockfish, depth 14.
